pick_implementation.title: Connect xCREAS
pick_implementation.description: Sign in to xCREAS in the browser window and confirm the authorization once. Home Assistant then follows your account automatically: devices you bind or accept to share appear on their own, and devices you unbind or stop sharing are removed — no re-authorization.

auth.title: Connect to xCREAS
auth.description: The xCREAS authorization was not completed. Open the link again and confirm the authorization.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect to xCREAS
reauth_confirm.description: The xCREAS authorization for your account needs to be renewed. Sign in with the SAME xCREAS account in the browser window and confirm the authorization again.

error.invalid_token: The xCREAS authorization expired. Start again.
error.insufficient_scope: The authorization is missing the required scope. Update the integration and start again.
error.device_not_authorized: A device is no longer accessible from your account. Check the device in the xCREAS app.
error.device_unavailable: The device state could not be read from the xCREAS cloud.
error.state_unavailable: The device state could not be read.
error.device_access_unavailable: The device access check failed on the xCREAS cloud.
error.snapshot_too_large: The account device list exceeds the cloud processing budget. Retry later or contact xCREAS support.
error.snapshot_invalid: The xCREAS cloud returned an incomplete device list. Try again.
error.service_unavailable: The xCREAS service is temporarily unavailable. Try again.
error.transport_error: Could not reach the xCREAS cloud. Check your connection and try again.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Please check the logs and try again.

abort.already_configured: This xCREAS account is already set up — the existing connection was refreshed.
abort.oauth_error: The xCREAS authorization was cancelled or failed.
abort.missing_configuration: The integration is missing its OAuth configuration.
abort.account_mismatch: The account you signed in with does not match this connection. Reconnect with the original xCREAS account, or remove this connection first and add the other account as a new connection.
abort.account_unresolved: The xCREAS cloud did not identify the account.
